source_frequency: N/A - no public daily dataset available
reason: No verified multi-year daily municipal water production/supply/consumption dataset exists for Gurgaon/Gurugram. MCG is establishing its first micro data centre and SCADA system (announced January 2026) with a 2-year implementation timeline. GMDA reports total supply capacity (670 MLD, expanding to 770 MLD) but does not publish daily production time-series. PHED Haryana provides rural LPCD status, not daily urban supply data. No open-data portal exposes downloadable daily water records for this city.
